MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 7

2. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

3. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

6. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

7. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 13

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 43
   C. 31
   D. 41

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

10. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

13. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
